description: meter (M0/Ledger only): measures per-node token spend, changes no tool behaviour. Registers only what M0 needs — SessionStart to boot the daemon, SubagentStart/SubagentStop to attribute tokens, one PreToolUse matcher on the Agent tool to correlate a spawn to its DAG-NODE marker, and SessionEnd for main-thread accounting and daemon refcounting. Later milestones (Clamp, Dossier, Echo, Vault) add PreToolUse/PostToolUse matchers on Read/Grep/Glob/Bash and PreCompact; none of that ships until M0 is producing real numbers (meter-handoff.md Section 0, Rule 1). Auth token header: works only if DAG_METER_TOKEN is exported in the shell that launches Claude Code, matching the value at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/meter/token (see meter/daemon.py's module docstring for why a SessionStart hook can't set this for you). Requests without it are still processed — see the same docstring for why that's safe in M0.
